events.text: The basket was empty again when I came back in the evening to pay.
Could we get one invoice at the end of the month for all our orders?

Checkout stopped with an error: the payment service took too long to answer.
I was not sure my order went through until the email came an hour later.
The size guide does not open on my phone. Nothing happens when I tap it.
Please keep my basket for later. It is empty every time I come back.
